evidence_gaps: No direct oral bioavailability measurement for chlorprednisone itself; the decision relies on a closely related chlorinated corticosteroid (BMP) and physicochemical priors.

BMP was measured as the active metabolite after oral administration of the dipropionate prodrug; the free 17-alcohol and absence of the 16-methyl group in the query may alter first-pass metabolism or absorption.
No data on intestinal efflux, first-pass hepatic extraction, or formulation effects for the query.
